row_statement: Conjecture 2 of Bean (the minimum size of a critical set in L(9), the addition table of the elementary abelian group Z_3 x Z_3, is 29) is false: an explicit set of 28 entries of L(9) has L(9) as its unique completion to a Latin square of order 9, and deleting any one entry gives a set with a second completion, so it is a critical set and the minimum is at most 28. The exact minimum is not determined.

caveats: Easy to find: a 40-line generic search finds 28-entry critical sets in 10 to 20 seconds and they are plentiful. No 27-entry critical set was found in an hour of non-exhaustive search; the known lower bound is 24.

Prior-art risk: Cavenagh's 2008 survey and one paper on autotopisms could not be opened; a 28 could exist unpublished or in an unread paper. Bean's own later papers and repository were read and have none.
The first reviewer's verdict was TRIVIAL on a formality; root and Opus overruled it with the source's text. A reader should know the call was not unanimous.
